about.title: An established Wakefield plumbing and heating firm
about.text:
SDW Plumbing is an established plumbing and heating company in Wakefield, handling everything from re-washering a tap to full bathroom refits and commercial installations.

Stuart and his team have years of experience between them, and some customers have trusted them with their boiler for more than a decade. Every photo on this site is their own work, not a brochure image.

items.name: Sharon B.
items.text: I have used SDW plumbing & heating for numerous jobs in our home including full bathroom installation, laying underfloor heating, boiler servicing & replacement and I have always found Stuart & his team to be nothing less than professional, punctual and value for money.

items.name: Olivia T.
items.text: My second phone call today I needed someone to come out to the house, within the same day they have been out to the house and got my boiler back working within the hour. I will definitely be using SDW plumbing for everything moving forward. Highly recommend.

items.name: Sheila M.
items.text: Efficient, reliable & competitively priced! When British Gas told me in 2013 that they could no longer get the parts for my 30 yr old boiler I turned to SDW plumbing! For over 10yrs they serviced my boiler & kept it running!

items.name: Ray S.
items.text: Great Plumbing Company with staff you can trust in your home. Their work is always tidy and efficient. We have been customers since the company started. Highly Recommended.

faqs.a: Yes. Quotations and estimates are free. Call us or send a few details about the job and we'll arrange a time to talk it through.

faqs.q: Which boilers and heating systems do you fit?
faqs.a: Combi boilers and full vented and unvented systems. We'll recommend the right setup for your home and how you use hot water.

faqs.q: How often should my boiler be serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year. An annual service keeps your boiler safe and efficient, and most manufacturers require it to keep the warranty valid.

faqs.q: Can you handle a whole bathroom, not just the plumbing?
faqs.a: Yes. We take care of the joinery, plumbing and tiling, from a small cloakroom to a full wet room, and help you choose along the way.

faqs.q: Do you do landlord gas safety checks?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry out landlord checks on gas appliances, as well as annual servicing for rental properties.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. As well as homes, we install and maintain plumbing and heating for commercial customers.
